Government of Malaysia MCTP Scholarship Details

The Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) aspires to attract a talented pool of candidates from developing nations to the country through the Malaysia Government Scholarship 2026.

The Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) was established in 1980 as Malaysia’s commitment to South-South Cooperation through the sharing of Malaysia’s development experiences and expertise with other developing countries.

The Malaysian Ministry of Higher  Education will not only provide you the chance to scale high-quality  education but also will help you enjoy the positives of Malaysia in a due manner.

Suppose you have a good academic background and an enthusiasm to do something different and bigger in your country. In that case, the Malaysian government is welcoming you with open arms under the global scholarship program.

The objectives of the MTCP Scholarships are:

  • To share experience with other developing countries;

  • To strengthen bilateral ties with developing countries;

  • To encourage and promote South-South Cooperation; and

  • To encourage and promote technical cooperation within developing countries.

Government of Malaysia MCTP Scholarship Requirements

An eligible candidate for the Government of Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme shall meet the following criteria:

  • Not more than 45 years old at the time of application.

  • intend to pursue full-time postgraduate studies (Master’s) in Malaysia.

  • Have obtain a minimum of Second Class Upper (Honours) or a minimum CGPA of 3.5 or equivalent at the Undergraduate Degree level.

  • Proof of English Language Proficiency:

    • Scanned copy of the original proof of English Language Proficiency such as IELTS (minimum total
      score 6) or TOEFL internet-based test (minimum total score of 60); or

    • Has obtained a previous degree(s) with English used as the medium of instruction.

  • Application is only open to applicants who have received a valid admission offer letter/s from at least one (1) university in Malaysia but have not yet started their postgraduate studies or those who have registered for no more than one semester for a Master’s Degree.

  • Has an excellent level of health certified by a doctor/physician. The cost of the medical check-up shall be fully borne by the applicant.

Required Documents for Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme

  • Application form (to be filled in the online system);

  • Latest Admission Offer Letter from Malaysian Universities for academic intake 2026 (Please refer to List of Universities).

  • Letter of Recommendation from two (2) referees;

  • Statement of Intent;\

  • A certified copy of Academic Transcript;

    • Record of all the courses taken throughout the degree programme must be reflected in the academic transcripts;

    • Applicants must submit transcripts of their undergraduate studies; and

    • Applicants must submit an official document issued by the applicant’s alma mater describing the university’s grade system. If an applicant’s transcript does not include information on CGPA, marks or score percentile, the documents must be certified.

How To Apply for Malaysia Government MCTP Scholarships 2026

To apply for the Government of Malaysia MCTP Scholarship, interested applicants should;

  • Read the details we have provided on this page and ensure your eligibility

  • apply first for admission to an eligible university via its respective application procedure.

  • click on the button below to visit the scholarship application page

  • create your account and login using your personal details.

  • fill out the application form and upload all required documents.
